about: Single source of truth for every art/sound file. The game loads the first of public/<roots.licensed>/<path>, public/<roots.cc0>/<path>, public/<roots.placeholder>/<path> that exists with the right size. Edit this file, then run `npm run assets:placeholders && npm run assets:docs`.

gameart2d-knight.name: GameArt2D: The Knight (free sprites)
gameart2d-knight.licence: CC0 / public domain: GameArt2D's licence page puts all Freebies under CC0 (checked 2026-11-15; the zips themselves contain no licence file). May be committed in public/assets/cc0/. Credit is optional.
